author: zDaniel
body:
To whom it may concern, 

I about 5 minutes ago I was banned for Crit Hacks [E]. I was reading through your appeal for ban straight away as this panicked me as a player of Avicus. IT says that if I do not have any hard evidence that I wasn't hacking that I shouldn't argue against it basically. So i won't. Instead I'll just apologise for the inconvenience. I'm extremely sorry. Extremely sorry for what I did and it would mean the absolute world to me if you would let me back onto this server. It literally means the world to me because all other servers are filled with corrupt mods and full of people that like to make fun of you when you're losing. But here, I am partnered with a  type of game where you're allowed to build freely and attack with such lenient rules. This is my favourite server, and its a way for me to come home and just let go of my stress from the day. I want to apologise again for the massive inconvenience and I hope that you can see it in your hearts to un-ban me someday. I will pay the consequences for my actions as I know they were wrong but I please ask that if you could unban me. I will never make an infringement on the rules again. I promise. And I know my word can't do this situation justice but unfortunately you'll just have to see it in the kindness in yourself to decide my consequences. I love avicus and I love playing it with all my friends. Please reply to this thread because its killing me knowing I can't play on this server permanently. 

Kind Regards


zDaniel

title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

Thank you for apologising. However, due to the fact that you did indeed hack, you will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
